description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Collective Agreement entered into between Finlays Properties (Pvt.) Limited and the United Tea, Rubber & Local Produce Workers Union (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a Memorandum of Understanding and Collective Agreement between a private company and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act.
